description: Authoritative secret-handling + rotation policy for the webhooks-api field app. Two distinct secret classes: (1) the platform tenant auth tokens, which are ENV-INJECTED only (server.mjs loadTenantTokens reads WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS; values never touch tracked source); and (2) the per-subscription webhook signing secrets, which are minted in core.mjs, returned to the caller EXACTLY ONCE on create + rotate-secret, and NEVER stored raw — only a sha256 fingerprint + last4 persist to data.json. This file declares NAMES, ownership, and rotation hygiene ONLY — it contains zero secret VALUES by construction.

secrets.name: WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS
secrets.description: Composite JSON env var consumed by server.mjs loadTenantTokens(): a {tenantId -> bearer-token} map. The single place tenant auth credentials enter the process. Absent/blank => deny-by-default (every request 401s). Values are injected by the deploy platform; never committed.

secrets.name: API_TOKEN_TENANT_A
secrets.description: Per-tenant bearer token for tenant A. Injected into the composite WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS map at deploy time; presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and compared in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual). Name only — value is never stored here or in any tracked file.

secrets.name: webhook_signing_secret
secrets.description: Per-subscription HMAC signing secret (whsec_…) minted by core.mjs newSecret() on createSubscription + rotateSecret. Returned to the caller in the JSON response EXACTLY ONCE; the store keeps only a sha256 fingerprint + the last 4 chars. So data.json holds zero recoverable signing secrets, and a leaked backup cannot forge a signature. Rotation is caller-driven via POST /subscriptions/:id/rotate-secret.
secrets.consumed_by: core.mjs:createSubscription / rotateSecret (returned once; never persisted raw)

static_secret_scan.scope: tracked source/config under WALTEUR_ROOT (.ts/.js/.mjs/.json/.env/.yml/... ), pruning node_modules/.git/walteur-kit
static_secret_scan.result: zero committed secret literals (signing secrets are runtime-minted and never persisted raw; only fingerprints appear on disk)
